Two of the three pooled variants exceed the bar for both families - the VETO verdict is robust to variant and span. Root cause of the false PASS: the D2 A5 schedules in the committed evidence (schedule_cells_proposals_v9_r2.json) are MONTHLY-grid +/-1 state maps keyed 'YYYY-MM|pair' spanning 1917-01..2026-07 (930 distinct months; e.g. '1949-01|USDCAD'), NOT the frozen daily S0 construction the proposals freeze, the p2 census and the runners implement - a representation change that was never frozen, disclosed, or adjudicated, and whose downsampling + pre-S0 dead keys destroyed exactly the daily co-exposure structure the gate exists to measure. The measurement port script is uncommitted (V7 committed compute_ancestry_rhos_v7.py; no V9 port exists in-tree), so the recorded numbers cannot be reproduced from committed bytes. CONSEQUENCE: the recorded A5 novelty PASSes (0.1062 / 0.0580) are refuted; as measured on the frozen representation, BOTH selected families are ANCESTRY_VETO, the selection freeze (6/6 cells) is invalid, and scored execution must not be authorized. findings.title: GB/CA legs consumed through current-vintage official tables; the mandated vintaged PIT channel is staged but unused
findings.detail: The frozen proposals (AX2-C1: 'as-of pulls only from staged vintaged archives; current-vintage pulls forbidden in scored paths', official tables = flagged tail continuation only where the vintaged archive ends inside S0) and the P3 freeze as_of_semantics ('official current-tables are continuation legs - the PIT qualification rests on the vintaged channel (P0 census)') mandate the vintaged channel for the conditioning values. The implementation (conditioning.build_economy_legs) instead reads GB and CA ENTIRELY from the current-vintage official tables (ONS D7BT, StatCan tidy) - both staged vintaged archives (GBRCPIALLMINMEI, CANCPIALLMINMEI; sha-manifested in fred_vintaged_manifest_v9.json) are present in staging and unconsumed. Effect: 2 of 5 legs' pi values across the whole of S0 are revised-in-place values rather than as-of-bound first prints - a PIT/spec deviation on the very property ('REALIZED inflation prints, announcement-instant availability, revision-integrity') that names this cycle's information set. The choice is disclosed only in code docstrings ('single self-consistent base per table' - a rebase-safety argument, not an as-of argument); it is NOT covered by any of the four i_a8 adjudications or any control artifact, and the Q dry-run evidence (135/198) certifies the deviating implementation, not the spec-conformant one. Mitigations recorded: availability INSTANTS still come from the pinned calendars (the event timing is PIT); the AU/NZ/US legs are vintaged and correct; the deviation does not inject PnL or bypass any gate. Remediation before any scored run: re-point GB/CA to the vintaged archives with official tables as flagged post-2025-03 tail legs only (staging already present), re-run I/Q, and re-measure D2 on the corrected legs - or record an explicit owner-ratified adjudication of the channel change.
